metadata.title: chrome_downgrade
metadata.description:
Script used to downgrade chrome to earlier editions (steps to proper downgrade 
-and retain older version- as described on official documentation):

- Remove/Replace relevant registry entries.
- Uninstall chrome, re-install older version.
- Disable dependent update services to prevent future updates.
- Rename Google Local Updates folder (where applic).

*Updated* - Tested on windows 10 x64.

findings.title: Network retrieval combined with code execution
findings.description: The same file contains both a network retrieval pattern and a dynamic execution pattern. This combination merits review and is not by itself proof of malicious intent.

evidence.snippet: $AllContent = Invoke-WebRequest -Uri "https://www.slimjet.com/chrome/google-chrome-old-version.php" -UseBasicParsing -Method Get  …  Start-Process powershell -Verb runAs ". {reg import $env:USERPROFILE\Downloads\chrome_update_remove.reg /reg:64}" -PassThru | Out-Null
